summary: 01/06/2021: Between 1:00 and 2:00 PM during a joint session of Congress to certify Electoral College votes, several hundred assailants attacked Capitol Police officers and breached the security perimeter of the United States Capitol complex in Washington, District of Columbia, United States. The assailants then entered the Capitol building and searched for members of Congress, assaulted responding police personnel, ransacked Congressional offices, and destroyed property for approximately four hours until 6:00 P.M. when police personnel were able to clear out the remaining assailants. One person was killed in the assault by police gunfire when she attempted to climb through a window and breach the Speaker's Lobby. At least 114 police officers and at least 68 assailants were injured, and several members of Congress and staff aides were forced to barricade during the incident. This was one of three related incidents near the U.S. Capitol on this date. In a post on the group's website two days before the attack, Oath Keepers leader Stewart Rhodes called for members to travel to Washington, D.C. on January 6 "in support of President Trump’s fight to defeat the enemies foreign and domestic who are attempting a coup, through the massive vote fraud and related attacks on our Republic." Rhodes and several other Oath Keepers were arrested and charged in connection with the attack. At least one member of the Proud Boys pleaded guilty to his involvement in the attack and several other members were arrested and charged. Authorities noted that members of the Proud Boys and Oath Keepers met 24 hours before the attack. Authorities also discovered several social media posts and encrypted messages that demonstrated prior coordination and planning for the January 6 attack, which was an attempt to prevent the confirmation of President Biden’s victory and keep former President Trump in office. Additionally, several assailants displayed confederate flags and displayed Oath Keepers, Proud Boys, Three Percenters, and QAnon conspiracy theory insignias during the attack.

No group claimed responsibility for the incident; however, sources attributed the attack to the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).
gname: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL)
scite1: "ISHM: JUNE 24 - JULY 1, 2021," Enabling Peace in Iraq Center, July 1, 2021.
scite2: "A Terrorist ISIS Attack On Hassan Shalal Village, South Of Kirkuk, Thwarted," National Iraqi News Agency (NINA), July 2, 2021.

summary: 06/30/2021: An explosive device detonated targeting an electricity pylon in Jangal Bagh, Parwan, Afghanistan. There were no reported casualties, but the pylon was damaged in the blast. No group claimed responsibility for the incident.
scite1: "Gunmen blow up power pylon in Parwan," Afghan Islamic Press, June 30, 2021.
scite2: "Provinces hit by blackout after power pylon destroyed," Asian Lite, July 1, 2021.

summary: 06/30/2021: Assailants abducted Reverend Father Elijah Juma Wada on the Damboa and Maiduguri road in Borno State, Nigeria. Wada was released on July 8, 2021. No group claimed responsibility for the incident; however, sources attributed the attack to the Al-Barnawi faction of Boko Haram (Islamic State West Africa Province-ISWAP).

summary: 06/30/2021: Security forces discovered and defused an explosive device planted along the highway between Caloto and Corinto in Cauca, Colombia. No group claimed responsibility for the incident; however, sources attributed the attempted attack to the Dagoberto Ramos Mobile Column of Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) dissidents.
gname: Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) dissidents
weapdetail: A roadside bomb was used in the attack.
scite1: "Two dead and one wounded after clashes between dissidents and army in Cauca," CE Noticias Financieras English, July 5, 2021.

location: The incident occurred in Muse district.
summary: 06/30/2021: An explosion occurred at a casino in Kaungmutone, Muse district, Shan, Myanmar. There were no reported casualties in the attack. No group claimed responsibility for the incident.
addnotes: There is doubt that this incident meets terrorism-related criteria. It is unclear if the explosion occurred intentionally.
